title: XKD: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation with Domain Alignment for Video Representation Learning

layout.note: Mirror-symmetric 2x2 of tracks: the top tracks hold the autoencoder and student (video flows left to right, audio right to left), the bottom tracks the hatched teachers; the two halves meet in the centre, where red curves and blue double arrows connect the feature bells.

lesson: Give each objective one saturated colour used on its arrow and on a same-colour italic label over a grey-and-black body, so the losses are told apart without a legend; mirror the two modalities so the cross-modal links meet in the centre.
